summary: Stains found anywhere are tahor, except near places where women stayed while tamei. The house of tumah of the Kutim makes tamei because they buried there babies who were born too early.

chunks.st: where Jews and gentiles reside are ritually pure, since they must not belong to Jews, who put away their stained garments.
